headline: Anthropic launches Claude Duet for collaborative AI-assisted coding
summary: Anthropic released Claude Duet, a new product enabling real-time collaborative coding with Claude AI. The launch generated significant developer attention across Hacker News and tech platforms, with concurrent coverage of Claude's expanding code generation capabilities and integrations with open-source tools. For healthcare AI specifically, Claude Duet accelerates the development of clinical decision support systems and EHR integration tools by reducing manual coding effort and security vulnerabilities. Healthcare vendors and consulting firms building AI-assisted workflows can leverage Claude Duet to ship compliant, auditable code faster. This positions Claude deeper in healthcare software development pipelines, directly competing with existing enterprise AI coding assistants in the clinical IT market.
